statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-33997 is a privilege-validation bypass in the Moby daemon's plugin installation. kubescape (the root package of kubescape/kubescape v4.0.15) links only Docker's client side. Checked with `go list -deps .` in the CI build (images run 37729575719, both arches), which listed github.com/docker/docker/client, api, the api/types/* packages, pkg/homedir and pkg/namesgenerator, and no daemon, plugin manager or api/server package. The build fails if one is ever linked. The fix (29.3.1) exists only under the github.com/moby/moby module path, so the +incompatible module cannot be floated to it.
